# llm-quota-router

> Zero-dependency Python multi-bucket LLM quota router with sticky prompt-cache affinity, HTTP 429 cooldowns, and circuit-breaker failover for AI agent loops.

## Key Components
- QuotaBucket: Rolling window capacity & automatic refill tracking.
- ProviderAccount: Isolated credential slot with model capabilities, priority, and cooldown state.
- CircuitBreaker: Closed / Open / Half-Open failure isolator.
- QuotaRouter: Deterministic selection + `execute_with_failover()` wrapper.
